    // ==============================================
    // D3.js Interactive Collapsible Tree
    // ==============================================
    
    let treeData = null;
    let svg = null;
    let g = null;
    let tree = null;
    let root = null;
    let margin, width, height; // Global dimensions for tree
    
    function initializeCareerTree() {
        console.log('🌳 Initializing D3.js Career Pathway Tree...');
        
        // Set up the SVG canvas
        const container = d3.select("#career-tree");
        const containerNode = container.node();
        const containerRect = containerNode.getBoundingClientRect();
        
        margin = { top: 20, right: 90, bottom: 30, left: 90 };
        width = Math.max(800, containerRect.width) - margin.left - margin.right;
        height = 550 - margin.top - margin.bottom;
        
        // Clear any existing SVG
        container.selectAll("*").remove();
        
        svg = container
            .append("svg")
            .attr("width", width + margin.left + margin.right)
            .attr("height", height + margin.top + margin.bottom);
        
        g = svg.append("g")
            .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);
        
        // Create tree layout
        tree = d3.tree().size([height, width]);
        
        // Clear any default loading - user will select jobs manually
        
        // Set up event handlers for new job-centric approach
        setupJobSearch();
        setupSliders();
        setupTreeControls();
        
        // Load initial job suggestions
        loadJobSuggestions();
    }
    
    async function loadJobFamilies() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/job-families');
            const families = await response.json();
            
            const selector = document.getElementById('family-selector');
            selector.innerHTML = '';
            
            families.forEach(family => {
                const option = document.createElement('option');
                option.value = family.name;
                option.textContent = `${family.name} (${family.job_count} jobs)`;
                selector.appendChild(option);
            });
            
            console.log('📋 Loaded job families:', families.length);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to load job families:', error);
        }
    }
    
    async function loadTreeData(family) {
        try {
            console.log(`🔄 Loading tree data for family: ${family}`);
            
            const response = await fetch(`/api/d3-tree-data?family=${encodeURIComponent(family)}`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.error) {
                console.error('❌ API Error:', data.error);
                showErrorMessage(`Failed to load data: ${data.error}`);
                return;
            }
            
            treeData = data;
            updateTree();
            
            console.log('✅ Tree data loaded successfully:', data);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to load tree data:', error);
            showErrorMessage('Failed to connect to database. Using mock data for demonstration.');
            
            // Fallback to mock data for demonstration
            treeData = createMockTreeData(family);
            updateTree();
        }
    }
    
    function createMockTreeData(family) {
        return {
            name: family,
            type: 'family',
            children: [
                {
                    name: 'Senior Data Analyst',
                    type: 'job',
                    id: 'mock-1',
                    family: family,
                    children: [
                        { name: 'Business Analyst', type: 'similar_job', id: 'mock-2', family: 'Finance', similarity: 0.85, size: 85 },
                        { name: 'Data Scientist', type: 'similar_job', id: 'mock-3', family: 'Technology', similarity: 0.78, size: 78 }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    name: 'Data Scientist Manager',
                    type: 'job',
                    id: 'mock-4',
                    family: family,
                    children: [
                        { name: 'Analytics Manager', type: 'similar_job', id: 'mock-5', family: 'Technology', similarity: 0.92, size: 92 },
                        { name: 'Risk Manager', type: 'similar_job', id: 'mock-6', family: 'Risk', similarity: 0.67, size: 67 }
                    ]
                }
            ]
        };
    }
    
    function updateTree() {
        if (!treeData) return;
        
        console.log('🎨 Updating tree visualization...');
        
        // Clear existing tree COMPLETELY to avoid DOM conflicts
        g.selectAll("*").remove();
        
        // Reset global counter
        i = 0;
        
        // Create hierarchy
        root = d3.hierarchy(treeData, d => d.children);
        root.x0 = height / 2;
        root.y0 = 0;
        
        // Give each node a unique ID for proper data binding
        root.descendants().forEach((d, index) => {
            d.id = d.data.id || `node-${index}`;
        });
        
        // Collapse all children initially except first level
        if (root.children) {
            root.children.forEach(collapse);
        }
        
        update(root);
    }
    
    function update(source) {
        const duration = 750;
        
        // Compute the tree layout
        const treeData = tree(root);
        const nodes = treeData.descendants();
        const links = treeData.descendants().slice(1);
        
        // Normalize for fixed-depth
        nodes.forEach(d => { d.y = d.depth * 180; });
        
        // ****************** Nodes section ***************************
        
        // Update the nodes with proper key function
        const node = g.selectAll('g.node')
            .data(nodes, d => d.id);
        
        // Enter any new nodes at the parent's previous position
        const nodeEnter = node.enter().append('g')
            .attr('class', 'node')
            .attr("transform", d => {
                const x = source.x0 || height / 2;
                const y = source.y0 || 0;
                return `translate(${y},${x})`;
            })
            .on('click', click)
            .on('mouseover', showTooltip)
            .on('mouseout', hideTooltip);
        
        // Add Circle for the nodes
        nodeEnter.append('circle')
            .attr('class', 'node')
            .attr('r', 1e-6)
            .style("fill", d => d._children ? "#dc2626" : getNodeColor(d.data.type))
            .style("stroke", "#333")
            .style("stroke-width", "2px")
            .style("cursor", "pointer");
        
        // Add labels for the nodes - include similarity % directly in node name
        nodeEnter.append('text')
            .attr("dy", "1.8em")  // Move labels below nodes
            .attr("x", 0)  // Center labels under nodes
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")  // Center text alignment
            .text(d => {
                let displayName = truncateText(d.data.name, 20);
                // Add similarity percentage directly to similar job names
                if (d.data.type === 'similar_job' && d.data.similarity_score > 0) {
                    displayName += ` (${Math.round(d.data.similarity_score * 100)}%)`;
                }
                return displayName;
            })
            .style("font-family", "Source Sans Pro, sans-serif")
            .style("font-size", "12px")
            .style("fill", "#374151")
            .style("cursor", "pointer");
        
        // Add similarity color indicators for similar jobs - make them more prominent
        nodeEnter.filter(d => d.data.type === 'similar_job' && d.data.similarity_score > 0)
            .append('text')
            .attr("dy", "3.2em")  // Position below the main label
            .attr("x", 0)  // Center under nodes
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")  // Center text alignment
            .text(d => {
                const similarity = d.data.similarity_score;
                                        // Similarity indicators removed - now using node colors with legend
            return "";
            })
            .style("font-family", "Source Sans Pro, sans-serif")
            .style("font-size", "10px")
            .style("font-weight", "bold")
            .style("fill", d => getSimilarityColor(d.data.similarity_score));
        
        // UPDATE
        const nodeUpdate = nodeEnter.merge(node);
        
        // Transition to the proper position for the node
        nodeUpdate.transition()
            .duration(duration)
            .attr("transform", d => {
                const x = d.x || 0;
                const y = d.y || 0;
                return `translate(${y},${x})`;
            });
        
        // Update the node attributes and style
        nodeUpdate.select('circle.node')
            .attr('r', d => getNodeSize(d.data))
            .style("fill", d => d._children ? "#dc2626" : getNodeColor(d.data.type));
        
        // Remove any exiting nodes
        const nodeExit = node.exit().transition()
            .duration(duration)
            .attr("transform", d => {
                const x = source.x || height / 2;
                const y = source.y || 0;
                return `translate(${y},${x})`;
            })
            .remove();
        
        // On exit reduce the node circles size to 0
        nodeExit.select('circle')
            .attr('r', 1e-6);
        
        // On exit reduce the opacity of text labels
        nodeExit.select('text')
            .style('fill-opacity', 1e-6);
        
        // ****************** links section ***************************
        
        // Update the links
        const link = g.selectAll('path.link')
            .data(links, d => d.id);
        
        // Enter any new links at the parent's previous position
        const linkEnter = link.enter().insert('path', "g")
            .attr("class", "link")
            .attr('d', d => {
                const o = {x: source.x0 || height / 2, y: source.y0 || 0};
                return diagonal(o, o);
            })
            .style("fill", "none")
            .style("stroke", "#94a3b8")
            .style("stroke-width", "2px");
        
        // UPDATE
        const linkUpdate = linkEnter.merge(link);
        
        // Transition back to the parent element position
        linkUpdate.transition()
            .duration(duration)
            .attr('d', d => diagonal(d, d.parent));
        
        // Removed floating link labels - similarity now shown directly in node names
        
        // Remove any exiting links
        link.exit().transition()
            .duration(duration)
            .attr('d', d => {
                const o = {x: source.x || height / 2, y: source.y || 0};
                return diagonal(o, o);
            })
            .remove();
        
        // Store the old positions for transition
        nodes.forEach(d => {
            d.x0 = d.x;
            d.y0 = d.y;
        });
    }
    
    // Helper functions
    let i = 0;
    
    function click(event, d) {
        console.log(`🖱️ Clicked node: ${d.data.name}, Level: ${d.data.level || d.depth}, Type: ${d.data.type}`);
        console.log(`Node has children: ${!!d.children}, Has _children: ${!!d._children}`);
        
        if (d.children) {
            console.log(`🔽 Collapsing ${d.children.length} children`);
            d._children = d.children;
            d.children = null;
        } else if (d._children) {
            console.log(`🔼 Expanding ${d._children.length} children`);
            d.children = d._children;
            d._children = null;
        } else {
            console.log(`⚠️ Node has no children to expand`);
            showNoMoreMatchesMessage(d);
        }
        
        update(d);
        
        // Show job details if available
        if (d.data.type !== 'family') {
            showJobDetails(d.data);
        }
    }
    
    function showNoMoreMatchesMessage(node) {
        // Get current similarity threshold
        const similaritySlider = document.getElementById('similarity-slider');
        const currentThreshold = similaritySlider ? parseInt(similaritySlider.value) : 70;
        
        // Create notification
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = 'fixed top-4 right-4 bg-yellow-100 border-l-4 border-yellow-500 p-4 rounded-md shadow-lg z-50 max-w-sm';
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex">
                <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                    <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                        <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="ml-3">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-medium text-yellow-800">No More Career Paths</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm text-yellow-700 mt-1">
                        No similar jobs found above ${currentThreshold}% similarity threshold.
                        Try lowering the similarity range or increasing tree depth.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="ml-auto pl-3">
                    <button onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.remove()" class="text-yellow-400 hover:text-yellow-600">
                        <svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(notification);
        
        // Auto-remove after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (notification.parentElement) {
                notification.remove();
            }
        }, 5000);
    }
    
    function collapse(d) {
        if (d.children) {
            d._children = d.children;
            d._children.forEach(collapse);
            d.children = null;
        }
    }
    
    function diagonal(s, d) {
        const sx = s.x || 0;
        const sy = s.y || 0;
        const dx = d.x || 0;
        const dy = d.y || 0;
        
        const path = `M ${sy} ${sx}
                     C ${(sy + dy) / 2} ${sx},
                       ${(sy + dy) / 2} ${dx},
                       ${dy} ${dx}`;
        return path;
    }
    
    function getNodeColor(type) {
        switch (type) {
            case 'root': return '#7c3aed';        // Purple for virtual root
            case 'family': return '#3b82f6';      // Blue
            case 'job': return '#059669';         // Green  
            case 'similar_job': return '#dc2626'; // Red
            default: return '#6b7280';            // Gray
        }
    }
    
    function getSimilarityColor(similarity) {
        // Color gradient from orange (low) to red (high)
        if (similarity >= 0.8) return '#16a34a';      // Green (high similarity)
        else if (similarity >= 0.6) return '#ca8a04';  // Yellow
        else if (similarity >= 0.4) return '#ea580c';  // Orange
        else if (similarity >= 0.2) return '#dc2626';  // Red
        else return '#94a3b8';                          // Gray (low similarity)
    }
    
    function getNodeSize(data) {
        switch (data.type) {
            case 'family': return 12;
            case 'job': return 8;
            case 'similar_job': return Math.max(4, (data.similarity_score || 0.5) * 10);
            default: return 6;
        }
    }
    
    function truncateText(text, maxLength) {
        if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
        return text.substring(0, maxLength - 3) + '...';
    }
    
    function showTooltip(event, d) {
        const tooltip = d3.select("body").append("div")
            .attr("class", "d3-tooltip")
            .style("position", "absolute")
            .style("padding", "8px")
            .style("background", "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)")
            .style("color", "white")
            .style("border-radius", "4px")
            .style("font-size", "12px")
            .style("font-family", "Source Sans Pro, sans-serif")
            .style("pointer-events", "none")
            .style("z-index", "1000");
        
        let tooltipText = d.data.name;
        if (d.data.similarity) {
            tooltipText += `<br>Similarity: ${Math.round(d.data.similarity * 100)}%`;
        }
        if (d.data.family && d.data.type !== 'family') {
            tooltipText += `<br>Family: ${d.data.family}`;
        }
        
        tooltip.html(tooltipText)
            .style("left", (event.pageX + 10) + "px")
            .style("top", (event.pageY - 10) + "px")
            .style("opacity", 1);
    }
    
    function hideTooltip() {
        d3.selectAll(".d3-tooltip").remove();
    }
    
    function showJobDetails(jobData) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('job-details-panel');
        const content = document.getElementById('job-details-content');

                    <p class="text-xs font-source font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">Job Title</p>

                <div>
                    <p class="text-xs font-source font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">Job Family</p>
                    <p class="text-sm font-source text-gray-900">${jobData.family || 'Unknown'}</p>
                </div>`;
        
        if (jobData.similarity_score) {

                    <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                        <span class="text-lg font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900">${Math.round(jobData.similarity_score * 100)}%</span>
                        <div class="flex-1 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2">
                            <div class="bg-red-600 h-2 rounded-full" style="width: ${jobData.similarity_score * 100}%"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
        }
        
        if (jobData.id) {
            html += `

                    <p class="text-xs font-source font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">Job Profile ID</p>

                </div>`;

        html += `
                <div class="pt-2">
                    <button onclick="hideJobDetails()" class="bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700 text-white font-source font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors duration-200 text-sm">
                        Close
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        content.innerHTML = html;
        panel.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    
    function hideJobDetails() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('job-details-panel');
        panel.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // ========== NEW JOB-CENTRIC FUNCTIONALITY ==========
    
    let selectedJobs = new Map(); // Map of job ID -> job object
    let searchTimeout = null;
    
    function setupJobSearch() {
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('job-search');
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('job-search-dropdown');
        
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
            clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
            searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                if (this.value.trim().length >= 2) {
                    searchJobs(this.value.trim());
                } else {
                    hideDropdown();
                }
            }, 300);
        });
        
        searchInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
            if (this.value.trim().length >= 2) {
                searchJobs(this.value.trim());
            } else {
                loadJobSuggestions();
            }
        });
        
        // Hide dropdown when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
                hideDropdown();
            }
        });
        
        // Clear all jobs button
        document.getElementById('clear-all-jobs').addEventListener('click', function() {
            selectedJobs.clear();
            updateSelectedJobsDisplay();
            updateBuildTreeButton();
        });
    }
    
    function setupSliders() {
        const similaritySlider = document.getElementById('similarity-slider');
        const depthSlider = document.getElementById('depth-slider');
        const similarityValue = document.getElementById('similarity-value');
        const depthValue = document.getElementById('depth-value');
        
        if (!similaritySlider || !depthSlider || !similarityValue || !depthValue) {
            console.error('❌ Slider elements not found');
            return;
        }
        
        similaritySlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (similarityValue) {
                similarityValue.textContent = this.value + '% - 99%';
            }
            updateBuildTreeButtonText();
        });
        
        depthSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (depthValue) {
                depthValue.textContent = this.value + ' level' + (this.value !== '1' ? 's' : '');
            }
            updateBuildTreeButtonText();
        });
    }
    
    function setupTreeControls() {
        document.getElementById('build-tree').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (selectedJobs.size > 0) {
                buildCareerTree();
            }
        });
    }
    
    async function searchJobs(query) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/search-all-jobs?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=20`);
            const jobs = await response.json();
            
            displayJobSearchResults(jobs);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to search jobs:', error);
            hideDropdown();
        }
    }
    
    async function loadJobSuggestions() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/search-all-jobs?limit=15');
            const jobs = await response.json();
            
            displayJobSearchResults(jobs, 'Popular Jobs');
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to load job suggestions:', error);
        }
    }
    
    function displayJobSearchResults(jobs, headerText = 'Search Results') {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('job-search-dropdown');
        
        if (jobs.length === 0) {
            dropdown.innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-3 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm font-source">
                    No jobs found
                </div>
            `;
        } else {
            dropdown.innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-2 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
                    <span class="text-xs font-source font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">${headerText}</span>
                </div>
                ${jobs.map(job => `
                    <div class="job-option p-3 hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0 ${selectedJobs.has(job.id) ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800' : ''}" 
                         data-job-id="${job.id}"
                         onclick="selectJob('${job.id}', '${job.title.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${job.family}')">
                        <div class="font-source font-medium text-sm">${job.title}</div>
                        <div class="font-source text-xs text-gray-600">${job.family}</div>
                        ${selectedJobs.has(job.id) ? '<div class="text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium mt-1">✓ Selected</div>' : ''}
                    </div>
                `).join('')}
            `;
        }
        
        dropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    
    function selectJob(jobId, jobTitle, jobFunction) {
        if (!selectedJobs.has(jobId)) {
            selectedJobs.set(jobId, {
                id: jobId,
                title: jobTitle,
                function: jobFunction
            });
            
            updateSelectedJobsDisplay();
            updateBuildTreeButton();
        }
        
        hideDropdown();
        document.getElementById('job-search').value = '';
    }
    
    function removeJob(jobId) {
        selectedJobs.delete(jobId);
        updateSelectedJobsDisplay();
        updateBuildTreeButton();
    }
    
    function updateSelectedJobsDisplay() {
        const container = document.getElementById('selected-jobs-container');
        
        if (selectedJobs.size === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<span class="text-gray-500 text-sm font-source">No jobs selected</span>';
            return;
        }
        
        container.innerHTML = Array.from(selectedJobs.values()).map(job => `
            <div class="inline-flex items-center bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-source mr-2 mb-2">
                <span class="mr-2">${job.title}</span>
                <button onclick="removeJob('${job.id}')" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 font-bold">×</button>
            </div>
        `).join('');
    }
    
    function updateBuildTreeButton() {
        updateBuildTreeButtonText();
    }
    
    function updateBuildTreeButtonText() {
        const button = document.getElementById('build-tree');
        const hasJobs = selectedJobs.size > 0;
        
        button.disabled = !hasJobs;
        
        if (!hasJobs) {
            button.textContent = 'Build Tree';
        } else {
            // Check if parameters have changed since last build
            const currentParams = getCurrentParameters();
            const hasChanged = hasParametersChanged(currentParams);
            
            if (hasChanged && lastBuiltTree) {
                button.textContent = `Refresh Tree (${selectedJobs.size} job${selectedJobs.size !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`;
                button.classList.remove('bg-red-600', 'hover:bg-red-700');
                button.classList.add('bg-blue-600', 'hover:bg-blue-700');
            } else {
                button.textContent = `Build Tree (${selectedJobs.size} job${selectedJobs.size !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`;
                button.classList.remove('bg-blue-600', 'hover:bg-blue-700');
                button.classList.add('bg-red-600', 'hover:bg-red-700');
            }
        }
    }
    
    let lastBuiltParameters = null;
    let lastBuiltTree = null;
    
    function getCurrentParameters() {
        const similaritySlider = document.getElementById('similarity-slider');
        const depthSlider = document.getElementById('depth-slider');
        const divisionFilter = document.getElementById('division-filter');
        const businessUnitFilter = document.getElementById('business-unit-filter');
        const locationFilter = document.getElementById('location-filter');
        const regionFilter = document.getElementById('region-filter');
        
        return {
            jobs: Array.from(selectedJobs.keys()).sort(),
            similarity: similaritySlider ? parseFloat(similaritySlider.value) / 100 : 0.7,
            depth: depthSlider ? parseInt(depthSlider.value) : 3,
            division: divisionFilter ? divisionFilter.value : '',
            business_unit: businessUnitFilter ? businessUnitFilter.value : '',
            location: locationFilter ? locationFilter.value : '',
            region: regionFilter ? regionFilter.value : ''
        };
    }
    
    function hasParametersChanged(currentParams) {
        if (!lastBuiltParameters) return false;
        
        return JSON.stringify(currentParams) !== JSON.stringify(lastBuiltParameters);
    }
    
    function hideDropdown() {
        document.getElementById('job-search-dropdown').classList.add('hidden');
    }
    
    async function buildCareerTree() {
        const currentParams = getCurrentParameters();
        const jobIds = currentParams.jobs;
        const similarity = currentParams.similarity;
        const depth = currentParams.depth;
        
        // Build organizational filter parameters
        const filters = [];
        if (currentParams.division) filters.push(`division=${encodeURIComponent(currentParams.division)}`);
        if (currentParams.business_unit) filters.push(`business_unit=${encodeURIComponent(currentParams.business_unit)}`);
        if (currentParams.location) filters.push(`location=${encodeURIComponent(currentParams.location)}`);
        if (currentParams.region) filters.push(`region=${encodeURIComponent(currentParams.region)}`);
        const filterString = filters.length > 0 ? '&' + filters.join('&') : '';
        
        try {
            console.log(`🌳 Building career tree for ${jobIds.length} jobs, similarity: ${similarity}, depth: ${depth}`);
            if (filters.length > 0) {
                console.log(`🔍 With organizational filters: ${filters.join(', ')}`);
            }
            
            // Show building indicator
            const button = document.getElementById('build-tree');
            const originalText = button.textContent;
            button.textContent = 'Building Tree...';
            button.disabled = true;
            
            const response = await fetch(`/api/d3-tree-data?jobs=${jobIds.join(',')}&similarity=${similarity}&depth=${depth}${filterString}`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            console.log('Raw API response:', data);
            
            if (!data.success) {
                console.error('❌ API Error:', data.error);
                showErrorMessage(`Failed to build tree: ${data.error}`);
                return;
            }
            
            treeData = data.tree;
            lastBuiltTree = data.tree;
            lastBuiltParameters = currentParams;
            
            updateTree();
            
            console.log(`✅ Career tree built: ${data.total_nodes} nodes across ${depth} levels`);
            console.log('Tree structure:', data.tree);
            
            // Debug: Show node levels
            if (data.tree && data.tree.children) {
                console.log('Root children:', data.tree.children.length);
                data.tree.children.forEach((child, i) => {
                    console.log(`Child ${i}:`, child.name, 'Level:', child.level, 'Children:', child.children ? child.children.length : 0);
                    if (child.children) {
                        child.children.forEach((grandchild, j) => {
                            console.log(`  Grandchild ${j}:`, grandchild.name, 'Level:', grandchild.level, 'Similarity:', grandchild.similarity_score, 'Children:', grandchild.children ? grandchild.children.length : 0);
                            
                            // Check for great-grandchildren (level 2+)
                            if (grandchild.children) {
                                grandchild.children.forEach((greatGrandchild, k) => {
                                    console.log(`    Great-grandchild ${k}:`, greatGrandchild.name, 'Level:', greatGrandchild.level, 'Similarity:', greatGrandchild.similarity_score);
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
            
            // Count nodes by level
            const levelCounts = {};
            function countLevels(node) {
                const level = node.level || 0;
                levelCounts[level] = (levelCounts[level] || 0) + 1;
                if (node.children) {
                    node.children.forEach(countLevels);
                }
            }
            if (data.tree) countLevels(data.tree);
            console.log('📊 Nodes by level:', levelCounts);
            
            showTreeStatus(data);
            
            // Update button state
            updateBuildTreeButtonText();
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to build career tree:', error);
            showErrorMessage('Failed to build career tree. Please try again.');
        } finally {
            // Re-enable button
            const button = document.getElementById('build-tree');
            button.disabled = selectedJobs.size === 0;
        }
    }
    
    function showTreeStatus(data) {
        const container = document.querySelector('#career-tree').parentElement;
        let statusElement = container.querySelector('.tree-status');
        
        if (statusElement) {
            statusElement.remove();
        }
        
        statusElement = document.createElement('div');
        statusElement.className = 'tree-status bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-md p-3 mb-4';
        statusElement.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex items-center">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 3v4M3 5h4M6 17v4m-2-2h4m5-16l2.286 6.857L21 12l-5.714 2.143L13 21l-2.286-6.857L5 12l5.714-2.143L13 3z"></path>
                </svg>
                <span class="text-sm font-source text-green-800">
                    <strong>Tree Built:</strong> ${data.selected_jobs.length} starting job${data.selected_jobs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}, 
                    ${Math.round(data.similarity_threshold * 100)}% similarity threshold, 
                    ${data.max_depth} level${data.max_depth !== 1 ? 's' : ''} deep 
                    (${data.total_nodes} total nodes)
                </span>
                <button onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove()" class="ml-auto text-green-600 hover:text-green-800">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
        
        container.insertBefore(statusElement, container.querySelector('.border.border-gray-200.rounded-lg'));
    }

    // Add test button for the tree
    function addTreeTestControl() {
        const testSection = document.querySelector('.fixed.bottom-4.right-4');
        if (testSection) {
            const treeButton = document.createElement('button');
            treeButton.onclick = testD3Tree;
            treeButton.className = 'w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded transition-colors mb-2';
            treeButton.textContent = 'Test D3.js Tree API';
            testSection.insertBefore(treeButton, testSection.children[0]);
        }
    }
    
    async function testD3Tree() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/d3-tree-data?family=Data%20%26%20Analytics');
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('D3 Tree data:', data);
            alert(`D3.js tree loaded successfully! Found ${data.children ? data.children.length : 0} jobs in ${data.name}`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('D3 Tree test failed:', error);
            alert('D3.js tree test failed - check console for details');
        }
    }
    
    // Add the test control after a delay to ensure testSection exists
    setTimeout(addTreeTestControl, 1000);

    // Initialize organizational filters
    async function initializeOrganizationalFilters() {
        try {
            // Load organizational data to populate dropdowns
            const response = await fetch('/api/organizational-data');
            const data = await response.json();
            
            // Populate Division dropdown
            const divisionSelect = document.getElementById('division-filter');
            if (divisionSelect && data.divisions) {
                data.divisions.forEach(division => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = division;
                    option.textContent = division;
                    divisionSelect.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
            
            // Populate Business Unit dropdown
            const businessUnitSelect = document.getElementById('business-unit-filter');
            if (businessUnitSelect && data.business_units) {
                data.business_units.forEach(unit => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = unit;
                    option.textContent = unit;
                    businessUnitSelect.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
            
            // Populate Location dropdown
            const locationSelect = document.getElementById('location-filter');
            if (locationSelect && data.locations) {
                data.locations.forEach(location => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = location;
                    option.textContent = location;
                    locationSelect.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
            
            // Populate Region dropdown
            const regionSelect = document.getElementById('region-filter');
            if (regionSelect && data.regions) {
                data.regions.forEach(region => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = region;
                    option.textContent = region;
                    regionSelect.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
            
            // Add event listeners to trigger tree refresh when filters change
            [divisionSelect, businessUnitSelect, locationSelect, regionSelect].forEach(select => {
                if (select) {
                    select.addEventListener('change', updateBuildTreeButtonText);
                }
            });
            
            console.log('✅ Organizational filters initialized');
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('⚠️ Could not load organizational data:', error.message);
            // Gracefully handle missing endpoint
        }
    }

    // Initialize filters when page loads
    initializeOrganizationalFilters();

    // ==============================================
    // Modal Management Functions
    // ==============================================
    
    // Global modal functions
    window.openModal = function(modalId) {
        const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);
        if (modal) {
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Prevent body scroll
            
            // Focus on the modal for accessibility
            modal.focus();
            
            // Add click outside to close
            modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === modal) {
                    closeModal(modalId);
                }
            });
            
            // Add escape key to close
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeModal(modalId);
                }
            });
            
            console.log(`🔓 Opened modal: ${modalId}`);
        }
    };
    
    window.closeModal = function(modalId) {
        const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);
        if (modal) {
            modal.classList.add('hidden');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'auto'; // Restore body scroll
            
            console.log(`🔒 Closed modal: ${modalId}`);
        }
    };
    
    // Enhanced modal functions for dynamic content
    window.openJobDetailsModal = function(jobData) {
        // Populate modal with real job data
        const modal = document.getElementById('job-details-modal');
        if (modal && jobData) {
            // Update modal content with real data
            const titleElement = modal.querySelector('.text-lg.font-epilogue.font-medium');
            if (titleElement) titleElement.textContent = jobData.title || 'Job Details';
            
            // Update job family
            const familyElements = modal.querySelectorAll('.text-sm.font-source.text-gray-900');
            if (familyElements[0]) familyElements[0].textContent = jobData.family || 'Unknown Family';
            
            // Update Job Profile ID
            const idElement = modal.querySelector('.font-mono.text-gray-600');
            if (idElement) idElement.textContent = jobData.id || 'Unknown ID';
            
            console.log('📋 Opening job details modal for:', jobData.title);
        }
        
        openModal('job-details-modal');
    };
    
    window.openSkillsComparisonModal = function(currentJob, targetJob) {
        // Populate modal with comparison data
        const modal = document.getElementById('skills-comparison-modal');
        if (modal && currentJob && targetJob) {
            // Update current job title
            const currentJobTitle = modal.querySelector('h4:contains("Current Role:")');
            if (currentJobTitle) {
                currentJobTitle.textContent = `Current Role: ${currentJob.title}`;
            }
            
            // Update target job title
            const targetJobTitle = modal.querySelector('h4:contains("Target Role:")');
            if (targetJobTitle) {
                targetJobTitle.textContent = `Target Role: ${targetJob.title}`;
            }
            
            console.log('🔍 Opening skills comparison modal:', currentJob.title, '→', targetJob.title);
        }
        
        openModal('skills-comparison-modal');
    };
    
    window.openCareerPathwayModal = function(pathwayData) {
        // Populate modal with pathway analysis data
        const modal = document.getElementById('career-pathway-modal');
        if (modal && pathwayData) {
            console.log('🛣️ Opening career pathway modal for:', pathwayData);
        }
        
        openModal('career-pathway-modal');
    };
    
    // Demo functions for component showcase
    window.demoJobDetails = function() {
        openJobDetailsModal({
            title: 'Senior Data Scientist',
            family: 'Technology - Data & Analytics',
            id: 'R0041.5',
            business_unit: 'Group Technology'
        });
    };
    
    window.demoSkillsComparison = function() {
        openSkillsComparisonModal(
            { title: 'Risk Analyst', family: 'Risk & Compliance' },
            { title: 'Data Scientist', family: 'Technology' }
        );
    };
    
    window.demoCareerPathway = function() {
        openCareerPathwayModal({
            from: 'Risk Analyst',
            to: 'Data Scientist',
            pathways: 3
        });
    };
    
    // Initialize modal demo functionality
    console.log('✅ Modal management system initialized');
    console.log('🎭 Available modals: job-details, skills-comparison, career-pathway');
</script>

<script>
// ===============================================================
// WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTIONS

// Job Profile Selection Data and Functions
let allJobProfiles = [
    { id: 'R0041.5', title: 'Senior Data Scientist', family: 'Technology - Data & Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0042.3', title: 'Principal Data Scientist', family: 'Technology - Data & Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0128.3', title: 'Principal Risk Analyst', family: 'Risk & Compliance - Credit Risk' },
    { id: 'R0089.1', title: 'Risk Data Analyst', family: 'Risk & Compliance - Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0076.2', title: 'Financial Controller', family: 'Finance - Management Accounting' },
    { id: 'R0203.4', title: 'Business Analyst', family: 'Technology - Business Analysis' },
    { id: 'R0156.2', title: 'Senior Business Analyst', family: 'Technology - Business Analysis' },
    { id: 'R0156.1', title: 'Product Manager', family: 'Customer - Product Development' },
    { id: 'R0203.5', title: 'Senior Product Analyst', family: 'Customer - Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0167.2', title: 'Financial Data Analyst', family: 'Finance - Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0124.4', title: 'Operations Research Analyst', family: 'Operations - Analytics' },
    { id: 'R0098.1', title: 'Machine Learning Engineer', family: 'Technology - Engineering' },
    { id: 'R0187.3', title: 'Credit Risk Analyst', family: 'Risk & Compliance - Credit Risk' },
    { id: 'R0089.3', title: 'Compliance Specialist', family: 'Risk & Compliance - Regulatory' },
    { id: 'R0234.1', title: 'Software Engineer', family: 'Technology - Engineering' },
    { id: 'R0145.2', title: 'UX Designer', family: 'Technology - Design' },
    { id: 'R0178.4', title: 'Project Manager', family: 'Operations - Project Management' },
    { id: 'R0267.1', title: 'Marketing Analyst', family: 'Customer - Marketing' },
    { id: 'R0198.3', title: 'Treasury Analyst', family: 'Finance - Treasury' },
    { id: 'R0223.2', title: 'Cybersecurity Specialist', family: 'Technology - Security' }
];

let selectedJobProfiles = [];
let filteredJobProfiles = [...allJobProfiles];

function initializeJobProfileSearch() {
    // Load job profiles from API in production
    // For now, using demo data above
    console.log('🔍 Initialized job profile search with', allJobProfiles.length, 'profiles');
}

function filterJobProfiles() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('workforce-job-search').value.toLowerCase();
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('job-profile-dropdown');
    const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('job-profile-options');
    
    if (searchTerm.length === 0) {
        filteredJobProfiles = [...allJobProfiles];
    } else {
        filteredJobProfiles = allJobProfiles.filter(profile => 
            profile.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
            profile.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
            profile.family.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        );
    }
    
    // Remove already selected profiles from dropdown
    const availableProfiles = filteredJobProfiles.filter(profile => 
        !selectedJobProfiles.some(selected => selected.id === profile.id)
    );
    
    // Populate dropdown options
    optionsContainer.innerHTML = availableProfiles.length > 0 
        ? availableProfiles.slice(0, 10).map(profile => `
            <div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0"
                 onmousedown="selectJobProfile('${profile.id}')">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div>
                        <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-900">${profile.title}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-500">${profile.id} • ${profile.family}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-xs font-source text-blue-600">Select</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `).join('')
        : `<div class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-source text-gray-500">No job profiles found</div>`;
    
    // Show dropdown if there are results and search term exists
    if (searchTerm.length > 0) {
        dropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
}

function showJobProfileDropdown() {
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('job-profile-dropdown');
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('workforce-job-search').value;
    
    if (searchTerm.length > 0) {
        filterJobProfiles();
        dropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
}

function hideJobProfileDropdown() {
    // Delay hiding to allow for click events
    setTimeout(() => {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('job-profile-dropdown');
        dropdown.classList.add('hidden');
    }, 150);
}

function selectJobProfile(profileId) {
    const profile = allJobProfiles.find(p => p.id === profileId);
    if (!profile || selectedJobProfiles.some(selected => selected.id === profileId)) {
        return;
    }
    
    selectedJobProfiles.push(profile);
    updateSelectedJobProfilesDisplay();
    
    // Clear search input and hide dropdown
    document.getElementById('workforce-job-search').value = '';
    document.getElementById('job-profile-dropdown').classList.add('hidden');
    
    console.log('✅ Selected job profile:', profile.title, '(' + profile.id + ')');
}

function removeJobProfile(profileId) {
    selectedJobProfiles = selectedJobProfiles.filter(profile => profile.id !== profileId);
    updateSelectedJobProfilesDisplay();
    
    console.log('❌ Removed job profile:', profileId);
}

function updateSelectedJobProfilesDisplay() {
    const container = document.getElementById('selected-job-profiles');
    
    if (selectedJobProfiles.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }
    
    container.innerHTML = selectedJobProfiles.map(profile => `
        <div class="inline-flex items-center bg-red-100 text-red-800 text-xs font-source font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
            <span class="mr-1">${profile.title}</span>
            <span class="text-red-600 font-mono text-xs">(${profile.id})</span>
            <button onclick="removeJobProfile('${profile.id}')" 
                    class="ml-2 text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 focus:outline-none">
                ×
            </button>
        </div>
    `).join('');
}

function clearAllJobProfiles() {
    selectedJobProfiles = [];
    updateSelectedJobProfilesDisplay();
    document.getElementById('workforce-job-search').value = '';
    console.log('🧹 Cleared all selected job profiles');
}

// Job Search & Discovery Functions
async function performWorkforceJobSearch() {
    // Check if any job profiles are selected
    if (selectedJobProfiles.length === 0) {
        alert('Please select at least one job profile to search.');
        return;
    }
    
    const familyFilter = document.getElementById('workforce-family-filter').value;
    const divisionFilter = document.getElementById('workforce-division-filter').value;
    const businessUnitFilter = document.getElementById('workforce-business-unit-filter').value;
    const levelFilter = document.getElementById('workforce-level-filter').value;
    const locationFilter = document.getElementById('workforce-location-filter').value;
    const similarityThreshold = document.getElementById('workforce-similarity-threshold').value;
    const resultsLimit = document.getElementById('workforce-results-limit').value;
    
    console.log('🔎 Performing workforce job search:', {
        selectedProfiles: selectedJobProfiles.map(p => p.id), 
        familyFilter, divisionFilter, businessUnitFilter, levelFilter, 
        locationFilter, similarityThreshold, resultsLimit
    });
    
    // Show loading state
    const resultsBody = document.getElementById('workforce-search-results');
    const resultsCount = document.getElementById('workforce-results-count');
    
    resultsBody.innerHTML = `
        <tr>
            <td colspan="7" class="px-6 py-8 text-center">
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center">
                    <div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-red-600 mb-4"></div>
                    <p class="text-sm font-source text-gray-600">Searching strategic workforce intelligence...</p>
                </div>
            </td>
        </tr>
    `;
    
    try {
        // Simulate API call - replace with actual endpoint
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
        
        // Demo results based on search criteria
        const demoResults = generateDemoWorkforceResults(selectedJobProfiles, familyFilter, divisionFilter, businessUnitFilter);
        
        resultsBody.innerHTML = demoResults.map(position => `
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <input type="checkbox" class="rounded border-gray-300 text-red-600 focus:ring-red-500" 
                           value="${position.checkboxValue}" onchange="updateWorkforceSelection()">
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div>
                        <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-900">${position.jobTitle}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-500">${position.jobProfileId}</div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source text-gray-900">
                    ${position.division}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source text-gray-900">
                    ${position.businessUnit}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div class="flex items-center">
                        <span class="text-lg font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900 mr-2">${position.positionCount}</span>
                        <span class="text-xs font-source text-gray-500">positions</span>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source text-gray-900">
                    <div class="text-xs font-mono text-gray-600">${position.locationSpread}</div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source">
                    <div class="flex space-x-2">
                        <button onclick="viewPositionDetails('${position.checkboxValue}')" 
                                class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-700 font-medium">
                            View Positions
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="findSimilarJobs('${position.jobProfileId}')" 
                                class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-700 font-medium">
                            Find Similar
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
        
        resultsCount.textContent = `${demoResults.length} jobs found`;
        
        console.log('✅ Workforce search completed:', demoResults.length, 'results');
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Error performing workforce search:', error);
        resultsBody.innerHTML = `
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7" class="px-6 py-8 text-center">
                    <p class="text-sm font-source text-gray-600">Error loading search results. Please try again.</p>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;
        resultsCount.textContent = '0 jobs found';
    }
}

        }
    ];
    
    // Start with selected job profiles

function clearWorkforceFilters() {
    // Clear job profile selection
    clearAllJobProfiles();
    
    // Clear other filters
    document.getElementById('workforce-family-filter').value = '';
    document.getElementById('workforce-division-filter').value = '';
    document.getElementById('workforce-business-unit-filter').value = '';

    document.getElementById('workforce-location-filter').value = '';
    document.getElementById('workforce-similarity-threshold').value = '0.6';
    document.getElementById('workforce-results-limit').value = '20';

function toggleAllWorkforceJobs() {
    const selectAll = document.getElementById('workforce-select-all');
    const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]');
    
    checkboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
        checkbox.checked = selectAll.checked;
    });
    
    updateWorkforceSelection();
}

function updateWorkforceSelection() {
    const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]:checked');
    const selectionActions = document.getElementById('workforce-selection-actions');
    const selectionCount = document.getElementById('workforce-selection-count');
    
    if (checkboxes.length > 0) {
        selectionActions.classList.remove('hidden');
        selectionCount.textContent = `${checkboxes.length} job${checkboxes.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected`;
    } else {
        selectionActions.classList.add('hidden');
    }
    
    // Update select all checkbox state
    const allCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]');
    const selectAll = document.getElementById('workforce-select-all');
    
    if (checkboxes.length === allCheckboxes.length && allCheckboxes.length > 0) {
        selectAll.checked = true;
        selectAll.indeterminate = false;
    } else if (checkboxes.length > 0) {
        selectAll.checked = false;
        selectAll.indeterminate = true;
    } else {
        selectAll.checked = false;
        selectAll.indeterminate = false;
    }
}

function viewPositionDetails(positionKey) {

    // Parse the position key to extract details
    const [jobProfileId, division, businessUnit] = positionKey.split('-');
    
    alert(`Position Details:\n\nJob Profile: ${jobProfileId}\nDivision: ${division.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}\nBusiness Unit: ${businessUnit.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}\n\nThis would show:\n• Individual position numbers\n• Employee names (if authorized)\n• Detailed location breakdown\n• Reporting structure\n• Position status`);
}

// Selection-based actions
function compareSelectedJobs() {
    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]:checked'))
                          .map(cb => cb.value);
    
    console.log('⚖️ Comparing selected jobs:', selected);
    
    if (selected.length < 2) {
        alert('Please select at least 2 jobs to compare.');
        return;
    }
    
    if (selected.length > 3) {
        alert('Please select no more than 3 jobs for comparison.');
        return;
    }
    
    alert(`Comparing jobs: ${selected.join(', ')}\n\nThis would open the Side-by-Side Job Comparison interface.`);
}

function analyseTransitionPaths() {
    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]:checked'))
                          .map(cb => cb.value);

    if (selected.length === 0) {
        alert('Please select jobs to analyse transition paths.');
        return;
    }
    
    alert(`Analysing transition paths for: ${selected.join(', ')}\n\nThis would open the Transition Assessment interface.`);
}

async function showJobSimilarityResults(jobId, jobTitle) {
    console.log('🔍 Loading similarity results for:', jobId, jobTitle);
    
    // Hide job search results and show similarity interface
    const searchSection = document.querySelector('.mb-12.border-t-4.border-red-600.pt-8');
    const similaritySection = document.getElementById('similarity-results-section');
    
    if (!similaritySection) {
        // Create similarity results section if it doesn't exist
        createSimilarityResultsSection(searchSection, jobId, jobTitle);
    } else {
        // Update existing section
        updateSimilarityResultsSection(jobId, jobTitle);
    }
    
    // Scroll to similarity results
    document.getElementById('similarity-results-section').scrollIntoView({ 
        behavior: 'smooth', 
        block: 'start' 
    });
}

    // Load similarity results
    loadSimilarityResults(jobId, jobTitle);
}

async function loadSimilarityResults(jobId, jobTitle) {
    const resultsTableBody = document.getElementById('similarity-results-table');
    
    // Show loading state
    resultsTableBody.innerHTML = `
        <tr>
            <td colspan="7" class="px-6 py-8 text-center">
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center">
                    <div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600 mb-4"></div>
                    <p class="text-sm font-source text-gray-600">Calculating job similarities...</p>
                </div>
            </td>
        </tr>
    `;
    
    try {
        // Simulate API call
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
        
        // Generate demo similarity results
        const similarityResults = generateDemoSimilarityResults(jobId, jobTitle);
        
        // Populate results table
        resultsTableBody.innerHTML = similarityResults.map((result, index) => `
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div class="flex items-center">
                        <span class="text-lg font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900">#${index + 1}</span>
                        ${index < 3 ? '<span class="ml-2 text-yellow-500">⭐</span>' : ''}
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div>
                        <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-900">${result.title}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-500">${result.id}</div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div class="flex items-center">
                        <div class="flex-1 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-3 mr-3 max-w-[80px]">
                            <div class="bg-blue-600 h-3 rounded-full" style="width: ${result.similarity}%"></div>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-sm font-source font-bold text-gray-900">${result.similarity}%</span>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div class="text-sm font-source text-gray-900">${result.family}</div>
                    ${result.crossFamily ? '<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-source font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 mt-1">Cross-Family</span>' : ''}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-source font-medium ${result.categoryBadge}">
                        ${result.category}
                    </span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source text-gray-900">
                    ${result.sharedSkills} skills
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-source">
                    <div class="flex space-x-2">
                        <button onclick="compareJobs('${jobId}', '${result.id}')" 
                                class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium">
                            Compare
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="viewTransitionAnalysis('${jobId}', '${result.id}')" 
                                class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium">
                            Transition
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
        
        console.log('✅ Similarity results loaded for:', jobId);
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Error loading similarity results:', error);
        resultsTableBody.innerHTML = `
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7" class="px-6 py-8 text-center">
                    <p class="text-sm font-source text-gray-600">Error loading similarity results. Please try again.</p>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;
    }
}

function showMethodologyTooltip(type) {
    const tooltips = {
        'similarity-calculation': 'Similarity scores are calculated using asymmetric skill coverage analysis, comparing the overlap of required skills between job profiles.',
        'similarity-scoring': 'Scores represent the percentage of skills from the target job that are present in the source job. Higher scores indicate better skill alignment.'
    };
    
    alert(`Methodology: ${type}\n\n${tooltips[type] || 'Detailed methodology documentation available in the platform help section.'}`);
}

    const jobTitle = jobRow.querySelector('.text-sm.font-source.font-medium.text-gray-900').textContent;
    
    showJobSimilarityResults(jobId, jobTitle);
};

async function showJobComparison(jobIds) {
    console.log('⚖️ Loading job comparison for:', jobIds);
    
    if (jobIds.length < 2 || jobIds.length > 3) {
        alert('Please select 2-3 jobs for comparison.');
        return;
    }
    
    // Hide other sections and show comparison interface
    const existingComparison = document.getElementById('job-comparison-section');
    if (existingComparison) {
        existingComparison.remove();
    }
    
    // Find where to insert (after similarity section if present, or after search section)
    const similaritySection = document.getElementById('similarity-results-section');
    const searchSection = document.querySelector('.mb-12.border-t-4.border-red-600.pt-8');
    const insertAfter = similaritySection || searchSection;
    
    createJobComparisonSection(insertAfter, jobIds);
    
    // Scroll to comparison
    document.getElementById('job-comparison-section').scrollIntoView({ 
        behavior: 'smooth', 
        block: 'start' 
    });
}

async function loadJobComparisonData(jobIds) {
    console.log('📊 Loading comparison data for jobs:', jobIds);
    
    try {
        // Simulate API call
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
        
        // Generate demo comparison data
        const comparisonData = generateDemoComparisonData(jobIds);
        
        // Populate job overview comparison
        populateJobOverview(comparisonData.jobs);
        
        // Populate skills summary
        populateSkillsSummary(comparisonData.skillsSummary);
        
        // Populate skills comparison table
        populateSkillsComparison(comparisonData.skillsComparison);
        
        // Populate transition analysis
        populateTransitionAnalysis(comparisonData.transitionAnalysis);
        
        console.log('✅ Job comparison data loaded');
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Error loading comparison data:', error);
    }
}

function populateJobOverview(jobs) {
    const overviewTable = document.getElementById('job-overview-comparison');
    
    const attributes = [
        { label: 'Job Profile ID', key: 'id' },
        { label: 'Job Title', key: 'title' },
        { label: 'Job Family', key: 'family' },
        { label: 'Career Level', key: 'level' },
        { label: 'Business Unit', key: 'businessUnit' },
        { label: 'Location', key: 'location' },
        { label: 'Total Skills', key: 'skillsCount' }
    ];
    
    overviewTable.innerHTML = attributes.map(attr => `
        <tr>
            <td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-700 bg-gray-50">
                ${attr.label}
            </td>
            ${jobs.map(job => `
                <td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-source text-gray-900">
                    ${job[attr.key]}
                </td>
            `).join('')}
        </tr>
    `).join('');
}

function populateSkillsSummary(summary) {
    const summaryCards = document.getElementById('skills-summary-cards');
    
    summaryCards.innerHTML = `
        <div class="text-center">
            <div class="text-3xl font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">${summary.sharedSkills}</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Shared Skills</div>
            <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-400 mt-1">Skills common to all jobs</div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="text-center">
            <div class="text-3xl font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">${summary.uniqueSkills.join(' / ')}</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Unique Skills</div>
            <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-400 mt-1">Skills specific to each job</div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="text-center">
            <div class="text-3xl font-epilogue font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">${Math.round((summary.sharedSkills / Math.max(...summary.totalSkills)) * 100)}%</div>
            <div class="text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Skills Overlap</div>
            <div class="text-xs font-source text-gray-400 mt-1">Percentage of skills alignment</div>
        </div>
    `;
}

function populateSkillsComparison(skillsData) {
    const skillsTable = document.getElementById('skills-comparison-table');
    
    skillsTable.innerHTML = skillsData.map(skill => `
        <tr>
            <td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-source font-medium text-gray-900">

                ${skill.category}
            </td>
            <td class="px-6 py-4 text-center">
                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-source font-medium ${
                    skill.job1 === 'Required' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' : 
                    skill.job1 === 'Preferred' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                    'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'

                    ${skill.job1}
                </span>
            </td>

                </span>

}

function showSkillsCategory(category) {
    // Update active button
    document.querySelectorAll('.skills-category-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('active', 'bg-green-100', 'text-green-800');
        btn.classList.add('text-gray-600', 'hover:bg-gray-100');
    });
    
    event.target.classList.add('active', 'bg-green-100', 'text-green-800');
    event.target.classList.remove('text-gray-600', 'hover:bg-gray-100');
    
    console.log('📋 Showing skills category:', category);
    // Implementation would filter the skills table based on category
}

function hideJobComparison() {
    const comparisonSection = document.getElementById('job-comparison-section');
    if (comparisonSection) {
        comparisonSection.remove();
    }
    console.log('🔙 Hidden job comparison interface');
}

// Update the compareSelectedJobs function to use the new comparison interface
window.compareSelectedJobs = function() {
    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#workforce-search-results input[type="checkbox"]:checked'))
                          .map(cb => cb.value);
    
    console.log('⚖️ Comparing selected jobs:', selected);
    
    if (selected.length < 2) {
        alert('Please select at least 2 jobs to compare.');
        return;
    }
    
    if (selected.length > 3) {
        alert('Please select no more than 3 jobs for comparison.');
        return;
    }
    
    showJobComparison(selected);
};

// Update the compareJobs function for similarity results
window.compareJobs = function(sourceJobId, targetJobId) {
    console.log('⚖️ Comparing jobs:', sourceJobId, 'vs', targetJobId);
    showJobComparison([sourceJobId, targetJobId]);
};
